name: fullstack-vue-naive
description: Full-stack project: Vue 3 + Naive UI frontend and Express backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
